gloss: to cross, to exceed, to surpass

definitions.explanation: To pass over or across something.
To go beyond a limit or amount.

examples.japanese: {国境|こっきょう}を{越|こ}える。
{川|かわ}を{泳|およ}いで{越|こ}えた。
{大|おお}きな{壁|かべ}を{越|こ}えて、やっと{目標|もくひょう}を{達成|たっせい}した。
examples.english: I overcame a big obstacle and finally achieved my goal.
examples.notes: Figurative usage: {壁|かべ}を{越|こ}える means to overcome a difficulty.

examples.japanese: {冬|ふゆ}の{峠|とうげ}を{越|こ}えるのは{危|あぶ}ないので、{別|べつ}の{道|みち}を{通|とお}ることにした。
examples.english: Crossing the mountain pass in winter is dangerous, so we decided to take a different route.

examples.japanese: {予算|よさん}を{越|こ}えてしまった。
{参加者|さんかしゃ}が{100人|ひゃくにん}を{超|こ}えた。
{今年|ことし}の{売上|うりあげ}は{去年|きょねん}を{大|おお}きく{超|こ}えている。
examples.english: This year's sales greatly exceed last year's.

examples.japanese: この{仕事|しごと}は{一人|ひとり}の{能力|のうりょく}を{超|こ}えているから、チームで{取|と}り{組|く}んだほうがいい。
examples.english: This job is beyond one person's ability, so it's better to work on it as a team.

notes:
{越|こ}える is an ichidan verb meaning to cross over or exceed.

KANJI VARIANTS:
- {越|こ}える: to cross (physical), to exceed
- {超|こ}える: to surpass, transcend (more abstract)

TRANSITIVITY:
- {越|こ}える (ichidan): to cross over
- {越|こ}す (godan): to pass, to move past

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {山|やま}を{越|こ}える: to cross a mountain
- {国境|こっきょう}を{越|こ}える: to cross a border
- {予算|よさん}を{越|こ}える: to exceed the budget
- {限界|げんかい}を{超|こ}える: to exceed limits

FIGURATIVE:
{壁|かべ}を{越|こ}える can mean overcoming obstacles.
